issues.description: Unsupported-delimiter ValueError is undocumented and validated lazily inside the param-present branch
issues.detail: The Raises clause only lists HTTPBadRequest, but passing an unsupported delimiter raises ValueError. Worse, the check only runs when the param is present, so a typo like delimiter='semicolon' silently no-ops on the default path. Validate the delimiter once at function entry and document the ValueError (or convert it to HTTPBadRequest) so the contract matches behavior.

issues.description: _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS conflates symbolic OpenAPI names with literal delimiter characters in one dict
issues.detail: The mapping mixes identity entries (',', '|', ' ') with symbolic aliases ('pipeDelimited', 'spaceDelimited') in a single namespace. This is hard to read, hides three no-op entries, and risks future collisions when a literal character matches an alias prefix. Split into a set of literals plus a small alias dict, or use a typed enum.

issues.description: Delimiter silently no-ops when the value is already a list from multiple param instances
issues.detail: When the param arrives as a list (e.g. repeated query keys), the delimiter branch is bypassed and no splitting occurs. This weakens the documented postcondition relative to caller expectations. Either re-split list elements, reject the combination explicitly, or call out the conditional postcondition more loudly than the current Note.

issues.description: Empty-segment and adjacent-delimiter behavior after split is undocumented and untested
issues.detail: str.split preserves empty segments, so 'a,,b' with delimiter=',' yields ['a','','b']. The docstring notes keep_blank_qs_values does not apply to secondary splitting but never states the resulting invariant. Add a one-line spec ('empty segments are preserved as empty strings') and a test that pins the behavior.

issues.description: Missing test for delimiter combined with missing param / default path
issues.detail: No test exercises get_param_as_list('missing', delimiter='pipeDelimited', default=[...]). This is precisely the branch where the lazy delimiter validation bug hides, and it is also the branch that pins the invariant 'delimiter has no effect when param is absent'. A two-line test would lock the contract.

synthesis.summary: The patch is small, well-scoped, and lands the happy paths cleanly with overloads and a news fragment, but it is under-audited on the edges. The dominant issue all three reviewers converge on is that delimiter validation is lazy and undocumented: an unsupported delimiter raises a bare ValueError only when the param happens to be present, and the Raises clause never mentions it. Secondary concerns are the muddled _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS table that mixes symbolic names with literal characters, a silent no-op when the value is already a list, and untested/undocumented behavior for empty segments and the missing-param-with-delimiter path. Fix the validation contract and add the pinning tests and it lands.
